notes.title: Development of new levels.
notes.content:
Whew, plus a couple more levels. It takes a lot of time and I definitely won't have time to realize a couple of interesting ideas. That's too bad!

1. Puzzles - skills - battles. Everything you need to know about this level. Oh yeah, you can also blow something up or break something.  

[previewyoutube=1Zp8xF1VV8w;full][/previewyoutube]


2. Another location where you'll have to wander a little bit in the dark with monsters and be very careful. 

[previewyoutube=o0vXQXtqwvY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 003
notes.content:
Notes on the patch ::  

 Added voice acting in English.
 The red fire of the Boss Poison Spider no longer kills.
 Fixed logic at the level.

notes.title: Patch 002
notes.content:
Patch notes::

 Added English translation of text.
 Fixed bugs with game settings.
 Fixed bug with run button.
 Changes were made to craft widget (show how many resources the player has).
 left alt or left ctrl - activates dodge.
 Fixed minor bugs in the game (Collisions, textures, NPC behavior or assistant behavior)
 Added hints for quickly finding door opening levers.

notes.title: Patch 001
notes.content:
Patch notes::

 Changes have been made to the "double jump" skill.
 Level collisions have been fixed.
 "Double jump" time has been reduced.
 Alchemy logic has been fixed.
 Corrections in combat logic.
